subject: Pricing & model mix - token volumes and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model mix - token volumes and next steps

Thanks for the call earlier, Samir - great to meet. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a tailored pricing estimate and mutual action plan.

Recap: BrightLayer is planning to add an LLM assistant and relevance pipeline for product search. Primary workloads: chat (user-facing assistant), embeddings for semantic search, and a small rerank pipeline for top-N results.

What we need from you (short answers are fine):
- Monthly active users (MAU) and expected daily active users (DAU)
- Avg messages per DAU per day (how many discrete chat turns)
- Avg tokens per chat message (input+assistant response) - ballpark is fine
- Approx embeddings/day and avg tokens per embedding (if applicable)
- Any expected burst patterns (weekdays vs weekends, peak QPS)
- Target budget range and whether you'd consider a committed monthly spend for better unit economics
- Desired model mix (approx % split across chat / embeddings / rerank)

To help, I attached a simple token estimate you can fill (brightlayer_token_estimate.xlsx) and our latest pricing sheet (redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf). As a planning target, many customers we work with aim for an all-in target of roughly $800-$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on model mix and commitment level - we can get below that with a committed capacity deal.

If you can reply with the rough numbers by EOD Friday I'll turn this into an initial quote and a short MAP (mutual action plan) for procurement.

Thanks - talk soon.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
redwood.com

Attachments: brightlayer_token_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix - token volumes and next steps

Thanks Marissa - really helpful recap. Quick answers below (ballpark figures):
- MAU: 150,000 (we expect ~20% to be weekly active, DAU ~30,000)
- Avg messages per DAU/day: ~3 (mix of short queries and 1 longer assist)
- Avg tokens per chat message: ~200 tokens (input+response)
- Embeddings: ~60,000/day (used for nightly indexing + some realtime upserts); avg tokens per embedding ~512
- Rerank: small - ~5% of requests hit rerank, ~100 tokens per rerank request
- Burst patterns: peak during US business hours; no extreme spikes expected initially
- Budget: targeting $25k-$40k / month to start; we could consider a 6-12 month committed spend if the numbers work

One question: what kind of $/1M tokens can Redwood get us to with that profile (committed vs on-demand)? Also curious on recommended model mix from your end - we're flexible but want to optimize for latency and cost.

If helpful I can put procurement on a thread next week.


Samir Patel
Head of Search & Relevance, BrightLayer
samir@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix - token volumes and next steps

Thanks Samir - this is perfect. I ran a quick back-of-envelope based on the numbers and included the calculation in the attached spreadsheet. High level thoughts and a few clarifying questions below.

Preliminary model mix (recommendation) - optimized for latency + cost while preserving quality:
- Chat (assistant): ~75% of token volume - primary user interactions (we'll serve these from a low-latency chat-optimized variant)
- Embeddings (indexing + search): ~20% of token volume - mostly batched/nightly indexing plus realtime upserts
- Rerank: ~5% of token volume - small but high-value calls (can use a smaller, cheaper rerank model)

Estimated monthly tokens (ballpark):
- Chat: 30,000 DAU * 3 messages/day * 200 tokens = 18,000,000 tokens/day => ~540,000,000 tokens/month
- Embeddings: 60,000/day * 512 tokens = ~30,720,000 tokens/day => ~921,600,000 tokens/month (note: embeddings are often charged per vector, we'll show both token- and vector-based pricing in the quote)
- Rerank: small - assume ~30,000 calls/day * 100 tokens = 3,000,000 tokens/day => ~90,000,000 tokens/month
- Total tokens/mo (rough): ~1.55B tokens

Unit economics and target $/1M tokens (all-in estimates):
- On-demand (no commit): ~$1,200-$1,500 per 1M tokens (varies by model family and sequence length)
- Committed monthly (6-12 months): ~$700-$900 per 1M tokens (depends on model mix and whether you want dedicated capacity for lower latency)
- With a multi-tier commit and caching/batching optimization we can often reach a target of ~$650-$800 per 1M tokens for production traffic similar to this profile

Notes/assumptions: these are starting points - embedding charges sometimes align to per-vector pricing which reduces effective token price for that workload. Also, dedicated capacity commitments and autoscaling policies can materially reduce unit costs for chat-heavy workloads.

A couple clarifying asks:
- Can you confirm the 60k/day embeddings number (is that total vectors created or upserts + reindex ops?)
- Are you likely to want sub-second latency for chat (we'd recommend dedicated lanes) or is 200-400ms acceptable initially?

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm the two items above and the willingness to consider a 6-12 month committed spend range (you mentioned $25k-$40k/mo)
2) I'll turn this into a short MAP and an initial numeric quote (attachments updated)
3) Procurement loop + security/compliance checklist (I'll include our SOC2 and privacy docs)

Internal note (cc'd): rishi, Dev - if we can get a $30k/mo commit with that token profile, I recommend offering a blended committed rate around $800 / 1M tokens with a 6-month minimum and a path to deeper discounts at 12 months / higher commit. Thoughts?


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: updated_brightlayer_token_estimate.xlsx, redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf

Quick internal follow-up (leaving on the thread so Samir can see the cadence):
- Agree with your calc and recommendation. For that ~1.55B tokens/mo profile, offer proposal:
  - Tier A (6-month commit, $30k/mo): blended $800 / 1M tokens (includes embedding vector pricing adjustments)
  - Tier B (12-month commit, $25k/mo effective after uplift): blended $650 / 1M tokens + reserved capacity lane for chat (lower p99 latency)
- Include explicit callouts in the MAP for: onboarding timeline, SSO + KMS requirements, and a 30-day performance review to validate latency/cost targets.

Marissa - I'll draft the MAP template and the initial term sheet. Dev - can you prepare a quick runbook on how we'd set up caching + batching for Chat to hit the cost targets?


Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
